summary: Commit a3da368c: features/spec-consistency.feature added with 18 scenarios (r1-r4, r6-r8, r10, r21-r28; r22-r26 as outlines). r5 retired so no scenario. features bindings ok. model check: 44 violations, 13 warnings, 75 unresolved, 0 file problems (none from this round). Two lines returned as questions.
questions: r9 "...when a step is complete, tell the person what model check finds before the next step": Reading 1: a step is each single fix (each term's gate pass, reworded scenario, question, drift finding). Reading 2: a step is each stage of fix mode (terms, rewording, questions, other drift).

r11 "checking-spec-consistency shall start only when the person asks for it, never during an integration or a formulation": Reading 1: integration and formulation never start it themselves; a person who asks mid-integration gets a pass. Reading 2: it does not start while an integration or formulation is under way, even when asked.
